summary: Reviewed all 10 formulas (quarticMandelbrot, airship, buffalo, zubieta, celticMandelbar, perpendicularTricorn, liar4, ok-34, cubic, chebyshev2) across all 7 units each (en + zh/pt/ko/ru/es/fr). Every English walkthrough cites nodeIds whose anchor roles/kinds match the described operation (e.g., airship loop/1 branch if abs(imag(z)) >= 1e-10; ok-34 loop/2 branch if horizontal <= vertical and LastSqr bailout; cubic strict |z| < test; liar4 |z| <= 1). mathSummary texts reproduce source loop statements verbatim. parameterExperiment.parameterSymbols use runtime slotName values (parameter1; multiplier/thresholdOffset/initialMap/orbitMap) with defaults matching the runtime slots; no-parameter formulas use pinned-profile repeat runs, which is permitted. Rights tokens are exact in all English facts objects: project-owned/publish-project-owned-native-recipe for the seven project-owned formulas; source-declared-public-domain-assumption/direct-adaptation/publish-census-full-chain-green for liar4 and cubic; no-explicit-permission/separated-independent-rewrite/publish-cleanroom-independent-rewrite-full-chain-green for ok-34. No broader third-party origin claims appear. Localized walkthrough key sets equal the English annotation sets in all 60 locale units; FRM-like/1 and all annotation/feature/parameter identifiers are preserved; no English fallback sentences found beyond protected code/profile tokens. Registers hold: pt você imperatives (use, execute, registre), ko 해요체 (실행돼요, 보세요, 기록하세요), ru formal вы imperatives (Используйте, Сравните), es tú (usa, registra, compara), fr tu (utilise, note, compare). Expected observations are framed as record-and-compare without guaranteed visual predictions. No visible contract drift in counts, IDs, revisions, or semantic hashes.
